cohort: The study included 378 postpartum mothers attending primary healthcare centres in Makkah, Saudi Arabia.
finding: The prevalence of PPD was 62.2%, with no significant association found between breastfeeding practices and PPD, but maternal age and cesarean delivery were significantly associated with PPD.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was significantly associated with PPD, with mothers undergoing C-sections having a higher odds of PPD.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from postpartum mothers between June and December 2024.
